title: fix(console): approvals inbox row figure is the object's declared highlightFields entry, not a name guess
body:

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBEaJzgBWzjWCNjBjkVoeRto)_

## 维护者速读

- 审批人在控制台审批收件箱里，每条申请旁的数字改为该对象「重点字段」里第一个数值字段的值；没声明这类字段的对象不再显示数字，按金额排序也跟着走。
- 属于「审批收尾」专题，替应用作者解决「收件箱按字段名猜金额、可能显示错数字且无法纠正」的问题。
- 出错时审批人看到的行内数字或排序不对，但打开申请页仍能看到全部正确数值；改动可直接撤回。
- 无

## What changes

The figure each approvals-inbox queue row shows after the object name, and the "Amount (high→low)" sort, now come from the request object's declared `highlightFields` (ADR-0085: one curated list of the object's most important fields, every surface; the spec docblock: "first entry wins where only one fits").

- **Rule:** the figure is the first `highlightFields` entry that names a numeric field of the object — `number`, `currency`, `percent`, `summary`, or a `formula` whose `returnType` is `number` / `currency` / `percent` — and that the object does not declare `hidden: true`. The value is read from the request's snapshot; `payload_display` formatting is kept.
- **Removed:** `AMOUNT_KEY_RE` and the name-matching scan (`decisionAmountEntry` becomes `declaredFigureEntry`). No new key (`approval.summaryField` / `listFigureField` are not built — seat route).
- **No declaration, no figure.** An object with no numeric `highlightFields` entry shows no figure and sinks in the amount sort. ⚠ **Visible change:** objects that show a guessed figure today and declare no numeric highlight lose it. Also stated in the changeset.
- **Zero-skip dropped:** a declared figure of 0 shows. The skip existed because a zero from a *guessed* key might not be the request's amount; a declared field's 0 is its value.
- **Hidden filter kept:** a highlight entry declared `hidden: true` is skipped (the next numeric entry wins); the sort never orders on it.
- **Same read, no new request:** the figure comes from the per-object `getObjectSchema` read the page already makes (one per distinct object per mount; the pinned cost test still asserts 2 reads for 3 rows across 2 objects). That read's hook lived in `hiddenFields.ts` and kept only the hidden-field names, so it now derives the figure field per object (`inboxFigureField` / `readInboxFigureField` / `useInboxFigureFieldByObject`). Until the read answers, or when it fails, the row shows no figure (before: a guessed one).

Files to read first, by risk:
1. `ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/hiddenFields.ts` — `inboxFigureField` (the rule) and the hook.
2. `ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx` — `declaredFigureEntry` and the amount-sort comparator.
3. `ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/ApprovalsInboxPage.queueHiddenAmount.test.tsx` — the fixture table in its header.

## Tests

Run at head `48abd08c`.

<details><summary>Whole console suite at 48abd08c: 329 files, 3507 tests passed</summary>

`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 apps/console` under `os-verify-lock.sh`: `Test Files 329 passed (329)`, `Tests 3507 passed (3507)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`. This run includes `consoleFaces.displayLocale-9909.test.tsx`, which went red in CI at `e6dddc0f` (`Test UI (2/16)`). Its 'ApprovalsInboxPage — queue' case, under de-DE and under en, pinned the old name-guessed figure: its object stub declared no `highlightFields`, so under the new rule the row showed no figure. At `48abd08c` the stub's `getObjectSchema` declares `amount` as a `number` field and lists it in `highlightFields`, and the case waits for the figure before it reads the face. Its assertions are unchanged (`1.234,5` under de-DE, `1,234.5` under en), so it still pins locale formatting of the figure. A grep of `ui/` for `AMOUNT_KEY_RE`, `decisionAmountEntry`, `useHiddenFieldsByObject` and `readHiddenFields` finds 0 hits. The only other figure-shaped text is the static HTML fixture in `ui/e2e/approvals-inbox-phone.spec.ts`, which does not run the page logic.
</details>

<details><summary>Affected test files: 2 files, 22 tests passed (at e6dddc0f)</summary>

`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 apps/console/src/pages/system/ApprovalsInboxPage.queueHiddenAmount.test.tsx apps/console/src/pages/system/hiddenFields.test.ts` under `os-verify-lock.sh`: `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 22 passed (22)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

- `ApprovalsInboxPage.queueHiddenAmount.test.tsx` was rewritten in place for the new rule. The fixture puts a money-named key (`total_amount`, `overdue_amount`, `service_fee`) before the declared field on every row, across two objects with different declarations. It pins the card's repro (`overdue_amount` 80,000 declared before the highlighted `total_score` 81 now shows 81), a hidden highlight entry being skipped, a declared 0 showing, no figure without a declaration, no figure when the read fails, the one-read-per-object cost, and the sort following the declaration (with a counter-probe and a hidden case).
- `hiddenFields.test.ts`: `inboxFigureField` order, both `fields` shapes, the numeric type set, formula `returnType`, hidden and undefined entries skipped, no declaration means null; `readInboxFigureField` never rejects.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation: the new page test against the base page and module</summary>

Both source files were put back to the base commit with `git restore --source=BASE` (test files kept). On disk afterwards: `AMOUNT_KEY_RE` 3 hits in the page, `inboxFigureField` 0 hits in the module. Result: `Tests 4 failed | 3 passed (7)`. The 4 behaviour pins went red (declared figure, no declaration, unknown declaration, sort sink). The 3 that pass are behaviour the base already had: the cost pin, the counter-probe (`service_fee` matches the old regex) and the hidden-sort case (the base trims hidden fields too). Restore: `git checkout HEAD -- …`, hash-checked against the HEAD blobs, `git diff HEAD` empty.

A first attempt restored only the page file. Its run was void: 7/7 failed on `useHiddenFieldsByObject is not a function`, an import error, not an assertion. It is not counted.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **File surface:** the order's surface is `ApprovalsInboxPage*.tsx` plus its tests. Three files are outside it, each declared as a deviation in the report:
  - `hiddenFields.ts` and `hiddenFields.test.ts`: the existing per-object read lives there, and the order says to reuse it rather than fetch twice.
  - `ui/apps/console/src/pages/consoleFaces.displayLocale-9909.test.tsx`: its approvals-queue case pinned the old name-guessed figure. Its fixture now declares the figure through `highlightFields`, and its assertions are unchanged.
- `isBookkeepingKey` was removed from the page; its only reader was the name scan. The `@object-ui/types` `isSystemManagedField` import went with it. A declared highlight is taken as the author's choice.
- The module keeps its file name `hiddenFields.ts`. Its header now describes both declarations it reads.
- The sort option keeps its label "Amount (high→low)". It now orders on the declared figure, which can be a score or a count rather than an amount (observation; no change made).
- No docs page describes the inbox figure today (`content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx` and `content/docs/capabilities/approvals.mdx` do not mention it), so no docs edit.

## Verification

Two-minute check: run the vitest command under Tests. Expected: `Tests 22 passed (22)`. In the running console, an object whose `highlightFields` lists a numeric field shows that field's value on each inbox row. An object without one shows no figure.

The gate readings below were taken at head `e6dddc0f`. The only later commit, `48abd08c`, changes one test file; the whole console suite was rerun on it (see Tests). CI at `48abd08c`: 46 check-runs, 33 success, 13 skipped.

<details><summary>Local gates: type-check, lint, 37/37 derived families exit 0</summary>

- `pnpm exec turbo run type-check --concurrency=2 --filter=@object-ui/console` under the lock: `Tasks: 76 successful, 76 total`, console `cache miss, executing`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`. The console `tsconfig.json` `include` is `src`, `dev`, `scripts` with no exclude, so it reaches the test files. (A first bare `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console run type-check` exited 2 on `Cannot find module '@object-ui/*'`: the dependency `dist` was not built yet. That was a prerequisite failure, not a verdict.)
- `pnpm --dir ui exec eslint` over the 4 changed source/test files: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 37 commands. Each was run, and each exited 0, with the exit code captured before any pipe. `--ran` reconciliation: `37 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 37 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`.
- Dogfood battery: n/a. The title has no `!` and there is no `(narrowing)` arm.
- Every family CI runs (the required UI lanes included) is CI's verdict on this PR.
</details>
